$comment: What the geometry build asserted last time it ran, so a silent change in the
source vintage cannot silently change the map. Every number here is measured, not
recalled; scripts/geometry/build_geometry.sh compares against it and fails the run.
Bump `version` and the release tag together when the source vintage changes.

source.$comment: Not TIGER. Median vertex spacing after the 20 m simplify is 292.9 m over 5,624,668 segments; at z10 one CSS pixel is ~117 m, so the median segment is ~2.5 px. TIGER would multiply file size for detail past the zoom this tileset publishes.

territory_filter.$comment: Coded replacement for an undocumented hand-edit. Keeps Puerto Rico (131 ZIPs) and the USVI (6), which have real market data. A4 asserts this exact list.

tileset.$comment: 92,590,855 B before. The cut is 2.0x, not the 4.6x first estimated, because that estimate assumed tippecanoe would keep dropping features to stay small — which is the bug this rebuild exists to fix. Carrying every ZCTA at low zoom is what costs the difference.

coverage.$comment: A7, measured by scripts/geometry/verify_coverage.mjs against the finished archive. Below z7 tile quantisation drops ZCTAs too small to see; the gate allows an absence only when the ZCTA's bounding box is under `max_dropped_px` CSS px at that zoom (512 px tiles). Measured largest absent: 0.12 px. A dot file used to be counted as covering them; the site never drew it, and it was removed 2026-09-24.

previous_polygons_by_zoom.$comment: The tileset this replaces, decoded by the same tool. It shipped a 5.8% loss at z3 and 2.5% at z4 — the default view — and nothing ever opened it to look.
